1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 b6 3.e3 Bb7 4.Bd3 e6 5.O-.strategy: With the king safe, the c-pawn takes space and presses on d5, giving White a solid centre of pawns on c4, d4 and e3 with the bishop aimed at the kingside. White gets a lasting space edge, Black a sound but slightly cramped game.
Gets the king to safety and completes the setup. Black has a sound, flexible position and can choose later between challenging the centre with a pawn or keeping the pressure on e4 with the pieces.
